verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents @mentions, shared notes, tasks, or rules that scope sensitive feedback to certain team members. The only nearby items are a candidate-rating API endpoint, a permission-sets listing endpoint and a member-invite endpoint. These are adjacent API building blocks, not the collaboration capability the story describes.
